title: AC1018 TABLE AcDbColor target-role closure
question: Does compound TABLE admission verify that a flagged AcDbColor handle resolves to an emitted object of the DBCOLOR custom class?

finding.before: The direct TABLE codec emitted an AcDbColor hard pointer when its common-header flag was set. The compound TABLE graph gate did not verify the target handle or its class role.
finding.change: Compound TABLE closure now checks flag/handle consistency, requires the target frame to be emitted, resolves its class instance, and requires the class definition names AcDbColor/DBCOLOR. This preserves the existing DBCOLOR writer route rather than rejecting all AcDbColor references.
finding.control: The generated TABLE graph vector changes the target to an un-emitted handle and verifies closure refusal; existing TABLE graph rollback/commit controls and the focused TABLE selector pass.
finding.scope: Target identity/role admission only. No successful full-file TABLE→DBCOLOR readback or native color meaning is established.
finding.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added; controls use generated in-memory objects.

validation.result: PASS: AC1018 TABLE encoder allocation failures injected=19 rollback=PASS retry=PASS; AC1018/AC1021 TABLE cell override vectors: PASS

limitations: The positive TABLE-to-DBCOLOR graph path still needs an end-to-end full-file output/readback control.
The class check does not establish native color/rendering semantics.
